summary.text: Melanie Scheible is a Democratic state senator from Nevada who has represented District 9 since 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Scheible assumed office in the Senate on November 7, 2018.

In the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists her as chair of the Senate Judiciary Committee, vice chair of the Senate Natural Resources Committee and a member of the Senate Commerce and Labor Committee.
